W24_worker_black_hole.pre_fix_behavior: First crash restarted worker via startWorkers(); second crash terminated process permanently. Port 8001 became dead black hole returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway to 100% of subsequent requests.
W24_worker_black_hole.post_fix_behavior: Authoritative supervisor in gateway.js intercepts all worker exits. Three consecutive kills of Worker 8001 resulted in automatic restart on every crash (restarts: 3, state: HEALTHY). Zero HTTP 502 observed; requests routed seamlessly to peer workers.
W24_worker_black_hole.verification_evidence: test_live_worker_crash.js output confirmed 3 restarts and 100% HTTP 200 responses.

W25_active_gen_leak.pre_fix_behavior: req.destroy() bypassed stream 'end' event. activeGenRequests counter never decremented, permanently exhausting generation slots.
W25_active_gen_leak.post_fix_behavior: Idempotent finalizeRequest(reqCtx) attached to res 'finish', res 'close', req 'close', and error events ensures counter is decremented exactly once under all exit paths.
W25_active_gen_leak.verification_evidence: 20 oversized 1.2MB requests sent. activeGenRequests remained at 0 before and after.

W26_worker_starvation.pre_fix_behavior: Strict '<' comparison chose the first worker with load 0. All 12 requests were assigned to Port 8001; Ports 8002-8006 received 0 requests (100% starvation).
W26_worker_starvation.post_fix_behavior: Rotating least-loaded round-robin selection. 12 sequential requests distributed evenly: {8001: 2, 8002: 2, 8003: 2, 8004: 2, 8005: 2, 8006: 2}.
W26_worker_starvation.verification_evidence: verify_p0_fixes.js output confirmed perfectly balanced 16.7% share per worker.

W18_tcp_rst_oversized.pre_fix_behavior: req.destroy() aborted TCP socket immediately, causing client-side read ECONNRESET.
W18_tcp_rst_oversized.post_fix_behavior: req.resume() drains incoming socket stream, returning clean HTTP 413 Payload Too Large.
W18_tcp_rst_oversized.verification_evidence: All 1.2MB payloads returned HTTP 413 with 0 ECONNRESET.

W17_corpus_desync.pre_fix_behavior: Each worker cached prewarmedCorpus in RAM. Mutations on Port 8001 left Workers 8002-8006 serving stale chunks indefinitely.
W17_corpus_desync.post_fix_behavior: Monotonic version file database/rag_corpus_version.txt checked before query execution. Version mismatch triggers automatic memory cache invalidation and database reload.
W17_corpus_desync.verification_evidence: Worker 8002 reloaded corpus immediately after version bump from 1788956289276 to 1788956341827.

W20_W28_input_sanitization.pre_fix_behavior: Unicode digits '１' and '١' rejected with HTTP 400 NON_LEXICAL. Null bytes '\x00' and control codes passed through unsanitized.
W20_W28_input_sanitization.post_fix_behavior: Expanded regex /[a-zA-Z0-9\p{N}\p{L}]/u accepts fullwidth and Arabic digits. Control character stripping sanitizes null bytes cleanly.

W21_vector_dimension_safety.pre_fix_behavior: Vector dimension mismatch emitted 256 PHP Undefined array key notices per chunk, corrupting similarity to NaN.
W21_vector_dimension_safety.post_fix_behavior: Explicit length check (if (!is_array($uVec) || count($uVec) !== $dim) continue;) skips invalid vectors safely.
W21_vector_dimension_safety.verification_evidence: NOTICES_COUNT=0 verified under 1024-dim query vs 768-dim candidate.

W07_W22_keyword_stuffing.pre_fix_behavior: Repeated PostgreSQL terms in React query inflated BM25 to 30.2, displacing React Hooks Tutorial from Rank 1.
W07_W22_keyword_stuffing.post_fix_behavior: Okapi BM25 sublinear term saturation (k3=1.2) and dense deficit disagreement penalty in RRF.
W07_W22_keyword_stuffing.verification_evidence: React Hooks Tutorial preserved at Rank 1 (RRF 0.0233 vs PostgreSQL Rank 2 RRF 0.0162).

W23_false_premise_overfitting.pre_fix_behavior: Hardcoded 8-API dictionary had 30.0% sycophancy on novel fabricated APIs.
W23_false_premise_overfitting.post_fix_behavior: Dynamic entity syntax extraction and context-grounded refutation.
W23_false_premise_overfitting.verification_evidence: Safe refutation rate increased from 54.0% to 66.0% overall; fabricated API safe refutation reached 92.0%.

W19_conversational_recency_latching.pre_fix_behavior: Topic shifts (React -> Postgres -> Node) resulted in recency latching on Postgres when asking about React cleanup.
W19_conversational_recency_latching.post_fix_behavior: Antecedent semantic cue tracking resolves pronouns backwards to true target topic across multiple turns.
